--- file:///.src/timeoutCatchTagToTimeoutOrElse_preview.ts ---
// @effect-v4
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics timeoutCatchTagToTimeoutOrElse:warning
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const fetchQuote: Effect.Effect<string>

export const quote = fetchQuote.pipe(Effect.timeoutOrElse({
    duration: "5 seconds",
    orElse: () => Effect.succeed("cached quote")
}))

export const maybeQuote = fetchQuote.pipe(
  Effect.timeout("5 seconds"),
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("TimeoutError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

=== [D2] Fix 2: "Replace with Effect.timeoutOption" ===

--- file:///.src/timeoutCatchTagToTimeoutOrElse_preview.ts ---
// @effect-v4
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics timeoutCatchTagToTimeoutOrElse:warning
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const fetchQuote: Effect.Effect<string>

export const quote = fetchQuote.pipe(
  Effect.timeout("5 seconds"),
  Effect.catchTag("TimeoutError", () => Effect.succeed("cached quote"))
)

export const maybeQuote = fetchQuote.pipe(Effect.timeoutOption("5 seconds"))
